scripts.start:all: npm install && npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix web/backoffice && npm install --prefix web/public && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run start:dev --prefix api" "npm run start --prefix web/backoffice" "npm run start --prefix web/public" "wait-on http://localhost:3000/health && npm run swagger --prefix api"
scripts.test:unit: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,backoffice,public "npm test --prefix api" "npm run test:headless --prefix web/backoffice" "npm run test:headless --prefix web/public"
scripts.test:contract: npm run test:contract --prefix api && npm run test:contract --prefix web/backoffice && npm run test:contract --prefix web/public
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:contract && npm run test:e2e
scripts.lint: npm run lint:check --prefix api && npm run lint:check --prefix web/public && npm run lint:check --prefix web/backoffice && npm run check:component-modules --prefix web/backoffice
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix api && npm run typecheck --prefix web/public && npm run typecheck --prefix web/backoffice
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix api && npm run build --prefix web/public && npm run build --prefix web/backoffice
